context_notes: Phase 6 shipped clean end-to-end: the te-XOR-li webhook signature parser bug (G-06-01) is fixed and PROVEN against real PayMongo traffic (a real pay-on-approval checkout confirmed booking 42132ab1 with payment_id pay_C4PW6fRGtUTNm6GsKCpt4P36; BOOK-06 email delivered via Resend id faa1481e). No open gaps, no open threats. PHASE 7 UX DESIGN THREAD (exploratory — NOT yet locked decisions; feed into /gsd-discuss-phase 7): (1) Booker/host feeds don't live-update — you must refresh to see an approval / a new request. Architectural (Server Components + revalidatePath, no WebSocket/SSE push). Backstopped by email (sendRequestApproved / sendNewRequestToHost). User wants a real notification so a booker can't miss 'you're approved, pay now' and forget. Cheap upgrade: TanStack Query poll + toast + visible countdown + a pre-expiry reminder + graceful re-request on expiry. (2) KEY INSIGHT: payment-window length and notification strength are COUPLED — a short window makes a missed notification fatal, so fix notifications FIRST. (3) User leans toward a fast 15-min payment window. Tension: request-to-book approval is async (host latency), so 15-min-from-approval punishes the booker for the host being slow. Better: start the booker's pay clock on ACKNOWLEDGMENT (when they open the approval), not on the host's click; cap the outer hold. Three models on the table: A Forgiving (long, capped at session start), B Live-fast (15-min from approval), C Acknowledgment-triggered (15-min from booker opening). Recommended: C + strong notification stack. (4) REAL CORRECTNESS GAP found (not just polish): both APPROVAL_PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS and APPROVAL_SLA_HOURS are flat now()+24h with NO cap at booking.starts_at (host-requests.ts:175). So a 2pm approval of a 5pm session holds/allows-pay until 2pm next day — past the session. Fix: expires_at = LEAST(now()+window, starts_at) and refuse approve/confirm once the session is imminent/past. Stakes are bounded (pay-on-approval = no charge until pay, D-63), so a lapse costs a slot not money. Constants are env-tunable in src/lib/payments/config.ts (D-64).
